title.narrative: CODE 1_2024 Promoting energy efficient cooking stoves and solar lighting in Port Loko district - a pilot project

description.narrative: Port Loko district has a population of 614,063 (2015 census). Production of food crops, such as rice, cassava and sweet potato, are the main livelihood sources for over 80% of the population. However, unregulated and non-mechanized agricultural practices coupled with massive deforestation through cutting down of trees for timber logging, firewood and charcoal burning poses threat to the environment and related negative impacts on the inhabitants. Key challenges in the the district include ignorance and low level of awareness regarding the efficient use of energy, non-affordability, lack of economic incentive, unreliable electricity supply, lack of willingness to pay for energy consumption, lack of quality control and standards, lack of human capacity, lack of enforcement mechanisms, availability of energy efficient products, lack of finance for energy efficiency and conservation programs, and lack of environmental pollution control mechanisms.
